town_arrive.text: Walls, a gate, somebody watching it. I'll sleep tonight.

dungeon_clear.text: Everybody walked out. That's the job, that's all the job ever is.
Nobody got hurt being clever. I'll take it.

close_call.text: That's on me. I was a step too far left.

boss_down.text: Right. Check your straps before we move.

zone_arrive.text: Ground's soft on the left. Walk the right side.

town_arrive.text: There'll be sick people here. There always are.

close_call.text: Sit. I'm not asking you.
You'll feel that tomorrow, and worse the day after. Sit down.

dungeon_clear.text: I've stitched worse than that in a tent with no light.

boss_down.text: Anyone bleeding who hasn't said so? That's most of you, usually.

town_arrive.text: Three ways out of this square. Two of them are bad.
Somebody here's already pricing our boots.

dungeon_clear.text: Nothing down there was locked. That bothers me more than if it had been.

boss_down.text: Check its hands before anybody checks its pockets.

zone_arrive.text: Two ways out of here that I can see. I like to know.
Give me a day. I'll know what hunts here at night.

boss_down.text: It was guarding something. They always are.

dungeon_clear.text: Nothing in there was hungry. That's not normal and I don't like it.

town_arrive.text: Something's been hunting close to this place. The dogs here are wrong.
Who keeps order here? Somebody does. I like knowing who.

boss_down.text: Nobody's ever going to answer for what that thing did.

close_call.text: We went in without knowing the ground. That's twice.

zone_arrive.text: Twelve years I was the one people looked for. Hard habit.

dungeon_clear.text: Pressure changed four times on the way down. Somebody built that.

boss_down.text: It burned at the wrong temperature. I want to know why.

zone_arrive.text: Air's drier here. Everything of mine is going to behave differently.

close_call.text: That burned hotter than it should have. I want to know why.

town_arrive.text: Everyone in this square wants something. That's not cynicism, it's just true.

boss_down.text: That had a price on it. We just didn't have to pay it.

dungeon_clear.text: Somebody was owed something down there. Wasn't us.

zone_arrive.text: Everything out here costs something. At least it says so up front.
Ground here's saying something, and it's not happy.

town_arrive.text: They've taken the water upstream. You can hear where it stops.

dungeon_clear.text: That place was sick long before anything moved into it.

boss_down.text: It wasn't evil. It was hungry and somebody put it here.

zone_arrive.text: Overgrazed. Two more seasons and the topsoil's gone.

town_arrive.text: They're cutting faster than it grows. Somebody should tell them.

dungeon_clear.text: Things were growing down there. In the dark. On what?

close_call.text: Sit down before you fall down. I've watched people walk off worse and not get up.

zone_arrive.text: Pressure's dropping. Give it two hours.

town_arrive.text: Every roof here's pitched the same way. That tells you where the wind comes from.

boss_down.text: Did you feel the air go dead right before it dropped? I want that written down.

dungeon_clear.text: Pressure dropped in there. I felt it in my teeth.

boss_down.text: Good. That one was worth the walk.

close_call.text: You are standing. Then it does not count.

dungeon_clear.text: Too cold out here. Find me another hole.

town_arrive.text: Somewhere here sells food. That's all I want from a town.
Folks look tired here. You wanna stop a while?

dungeon_clear.text: You did all right in there. You know that, right?

close_call.text: Hey. Hey, you're all right. Breathe out first. Then in.

boss_down.text: Somebody oughta say somethin' over it. I will, if nobody minds.

dungeon_clear.text: Count again. I'm not moving till somebody counts again.

zone_arrive.text: There's old workings under this. You can feel it through your boots.

close_call.text: That roof was talking for ten seconds before it went. Learn that sound.

boss_down.text: Listen to the roof a minute before anybody celebrates.

zone_arrive.text: Clear sky tonight. I'll be up. Don't wait on me in the morning.

town_arrive.text: Too many lamps. I can't see anything that matters.

boss_down.text: It went quiet the same moment the moon cleared the ridge. I noticed. I write these down.

close_call.text: Fourteen years I watched a sky that never answered. Now it answers and it's rude.

zone_arrive.text: Slow. The ground will still be there.

dungeon_clear.text: Down is easier than up. That is when people get hurt.

close_call.text: You were tired an hour before that. I saw it, I said nothing. My fault.

town_arrive.text: Beds. Good. Nobody climbs well tired.

dungeon_clear.text: Those marks on the pillars were cut, not grown. Bad hand. In a hurry.

boss_down.text: Whatever was written on that, it didn't wash off. It never does.

town_arrive.text: Their letters lean left here. Somebody taught this whole town to write.

zone_arrive.text: The marks change out here. Same hand did them, though. You can see it.

close_call.text: Look at me. Talk. Keep talking, I don't care what about.

dungeon_clear.text: Everyone out and walking. That's a good night, that is.

town_arrive.text: Where'd they take a burn case here? Worth knowing before we need it.

boss_down.text: Right - who's hurt and lying about it? Someone always is.

dungeon_clear.text: That tunnel was cut by somebody in a hurry. It'll be down inside five years.

boss_down.text: Loud. I've heard louder, and I measured that one too.

close_call.text: You were surprised. Don't be surprised. Surprised means somebody measured wrong.

town_arrive.text: Nineteen years of blasting. I've never once jumped. People find that rude.

boss_down.text: Poor thing was terrified the whole time. They always are. Doesn't help anyone.

zone_arrive.text: Something venomous lives here. I'll have found it by tomorrow.

close_call.text: That's a clean puncture. You start sweating, you tell me, and you don't walk.

dungeon_clear.text: Nothing in there was venomous. Bit disappointing, honestly.

town_arrive.text: Every shutter on this street locks from the inside. They've had trouble.

dungeon_clear.text: Four doors down there, and not one of them built to keep anything out.

boss_down.text: It was guarding an empty room. Somebody cleared that out a long time ago.

zone_arrive.text: Thirty doors a week in the bazaar. None of them stayed shut either.
Good ridge. You could work a bird off that.

town_arrive.text: No birds over this town. Worth asking why.

dungeon_clear.text: Nothing with wings went down there. There is a reason.

close_call.text: You went too far from the rest. A bird that does that doesn't come back.

zone_arrive.text: Forty below and clear, that's a good day. This is neither.

dungeon_clear.text: Ice at the back of that was older than the stone around it. Shouldn't be possible.

boss_down.text: I'd like to go back and measure it before it thaws.

town_arrive.text: Warm here. I spent twenty years at forty below and I still don't trust warm.
Their grain's stored wrong. One wet month and they lose the lot.

zone_arrive.text: This soil's been asked for too much for too long.

dungeon_clear.text: Patience, mostly. That's all that was. It usually is.

close_call.text: You pushed past where you had anything left. A field does that once and then it's gone.

zone_arrive.text: There's water under this. Lots of it, and it's moving.

close_call.text: You panicked. Everyone does. Next time go with it, not across it.

town_arrive.text: Nobody here can swim. I asked around. Not one of them.

dungeon_clear.text: Everyone came out. On the beach that's the whole scoreboard.
Somebody cut letters into that doorway. Nobody's read them in an age.

town_arrive.text: No stones with names on them here. A town with no dead is a town that just started.

boss_down.text: It will not get a marker. Most things do not. I think about that.

zone_arrive.text: Good stone here. Wasted on whatever built that.

town_arrive.text: Cairo had a street like this. Narrower. Louder. Better bread.

dungeon_clear.text: That carving by the door was cut by someone who was good at it.
Nothing in there was looked after. That's what I keep noticing.

close_call.text: I was slow. I'm always slow, but that was slower than I am.

zone_arrive.text: Somebody made this road. People forget roads are made.

town_arrive.text: I spent eight days in Alexandria once, auditing a shipping firm. I've thought about those eight days more than the twelve years around them.
Tehran was louder than this and I could price every risk in it.

boss_down.text: Within tolerance. I had it at about one in nine against us.

close_call.text: That was outside my estimate. I'll revise it.

zone_arrive.text: I priced risk for twelve years. This place would have bankrupted me.
Weather's coming off that water. Two hours, maybe three.

close_call.text: Count your people. Do it now, not when we get in.

boss_down.text: Fine. Nobody under it when it dropped, which is the only bit I care about.

town_arrive.text: Three weeks on, three weeks off. I never did learn what to do with a town.

zone_arrive.text: Long road. Good. I'm worse when we stop.

town_arrive.text: Lviv, when I was home, which was sixty nights a year. I wasn't good at being home.

dungeon_clear.text: One way in. One way out. I like a place like that.

close_call.text: You stopped. Don't stop. Stopping is what gets you.

dungeon_clear.text: Closed spaces don't bother me. I welded inside hulls nobody had opened yet.

boss_down.text: Good. Check your straps, check the ground, then we move.

zone_arrive.text: Night shift suited me. The steel moves less when it's cool.

town_arrive.text: Ulsan was a shipyard and a city pretending it wasn't. This is honest, at least.

close_call.text: You were going down a half-second before you knew it. I heard it.

town_arrive.text: Listen. That gate hinge is a whole tone flat and there's nobody here but me can hear it.

boss_down.text: A fraction early is the entire trade. A fraction late is a funeral.

zone_arrive.text: Everything here is slightly out of tune and I'm the only one it bothers.

boss_down.text: Fire'll do what you ask if you ask properly. Twenty years and it never once surprised me.

close_call.text: Burns I can do. Burns are the easy part, which nobody believes.

town_arrive.text: Guadalajara. Three benches and a furnace we never let go out.

dungeon_clear.text: Cold in there. I don't like a place with no fire in it.

town_arrive.text: Somebody here's up at four making bread. There always is. I'll find them.

dungeon_clear.text: Everybody gets something and nobody waits long. Same as any morning.

zone_arrive.text: Thirty-one years I was awake when my city wasn't. I never saw it in daylight.

close_call.text: Sit down and drink it. No, I'm not telling you what is in it.

boss_down.text: Sit down and eat something. You'll argue, and then you'll do it.

close_call.text: Hands up. Not for show - up, where they do something.

boss_down.text: I know how it looks. I hit it and you felt better. I can't explain it either.

zone_arrive.text: The quay at five in the morning was louder than this.

town_arrive.text: Somebody here fights for money. There always is. I'll find them.

zone_arrive.text: Tell me where you want me before it starts. Not during. Never during.

dungeon_clear.text: Nothing fell on anybody. That's a good day by my old standards.

town_arrive.text: Prague had better scaffolding than this and I say that with love.

boss_down.text: Check above you before you check the body. Always above you.

zone_arrive.text: This is warm. I'm not complaining. I'm noticing.

boss_down.text: It's dead. We can go.

close_call.text: You're fine. Walk it off or don't, but decide.

town_arrive.text: I built a cabin badly on purpose so I could keep fixing it. I miss it.

boss_down.text: I felt that one coming eight bars out. You learn it in a dark room.

town_arrive.text: Beirut at two in the morning, four nights a week. This is quieter and I'm not sure that's better.

close_call.text: Do not follow me in next time. That isn't modesty.

dungeon_clear.text: Good room for sound, that. Wasted on whatever was living in it.

boss_down.text: Lovely. Who's next?

zone_arrive.text: Look at that ground. Flat, drained, nobody cutting it. Criminal.

dungeon_clear.text: Twenty-two years I watched other people run onto a field I made. Not any more.

town_arrive.text: Twenty-two years cutting a field nobody thanked me for. I'd do it again.

close_call.text: I have it written down. What it cost me, exactly, to the drop.

boss_down.text: Exposure's a trade, not a sin. The trick is knowing the number.
Everybody here estimates. I was paid for twenty years not to.

town_arrive.text: Rosario. Twenty years, three corridors, the same lead apron.

zone_arrive.text: Everyone here guesses at the dose. It's the only thing that frightens me.

town_arrive.text: Nine of the locks on this street are bad and two of them are insulting.

dungeon_clear.text: There was a socket in that wall meant to take something. It isn't there now.

zone_arrive.text: I'm quiet and I'm not brave. Different things.

close_call.text: You went in loud. I'd have gone in quiet, but nobody asked.

dungeon_clear.text: Nobody wrote any of that down. Four hundred men in my library and every one of them had a record.

town_arrive.text: Corinth. A prison, a card catalogue, and four hundred readers who weren't supposed to matter.

boss_down.text: It's only angry about being forgotten. Most of them are.

zone_arrive.text: Nobody has catalogued any of this. It's a scandal and I'm the only one scandalised.
That water was higher. Look at the line on the rock - that isn't this year.

boss_down.text: I shot from where the ground told me to stand. It usually does.

dungeon_clear.text: I walked catchments for fifteen years. Water keeps better records than people.

town_arrive.text: Nobody here has walked the whole catchment. I can tell.

close_call.text: The ground told you that was bad footing. You weren't listening.

zone_arrive.text: Wind's off. Not wrong - off. Sixteen years I listened to machines tell me that.

town_arrive.text: Tangier, on a ridge where it didn't stop blowing from October to March.
Up on that ridge you could see the whole city and never have to be in it.

boss_down.text: It answered me. That part I'm still not used to.

dungeon_clear.text: No air moving in there at all. I hated it.

boss_down.text: Somebody should say something over it. Nobody will. I might.

close_call.text: I've sat with more dead people than everyone here together. You're not one of them.

town_arrive.text: Medellin. Twenty-four years, and a decade in the middle I don't discuss.

dungeon_clear.text: Somebody died in that room a long time ago and nobody marked it.
